# Shop

> The API reference of Shop.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. This reference documents release `v1`, which is supported until `2027-01-01`; the current release is `v4`, which has a reference of its own: [v4](../v4/llms.txt). Send `Crucible-Version: v1` on every request you make; an operation a third party calls says what its sender sends instead. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [CountItems](src/operations/API_CountItems.md): `GET /count`.
- [DeleteItem](src/operations/API_DeleteItem.md): `DELETE /items/{id}`.
- [GetItem](src/operations/API_GetItem.md): `GET /items/{id}`.
- [GetLabel](src/operations/API_GetLabel.md): `GET /labels/{id}`. One label\.
- [ListItems](src/operations/API_ListItems.md): `GET /items`.
- [ListLabels](src/operations/API_ListLabels.md): `GET /labels`. Every label on the shelf\, and the kinds of item they mark\.
- [PutLabel](src/operations/API_PutLabel.md): `PUT /labels/{id}`. Replaces a label\.
- [RecordPayment](src/operations/API_RecordPayment.md): `POST /payments`. Called by Payments, which signs it in the `Payment-Signature` header. A payment processor\'s delivery \(decision 81\)\.

## Data types

- [InternalServerException](src/shapes/InternalServerException.md): error, HTTP 500. An unexpected server failure\.
- [ValidationException](src/shapes/ValidationException.md): error, HTTP 400. A request cannot be parsed or does not satisfy the service\'s input model\.
- [ValidationExceptionField](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionField.md): structure. A request field that failed validation\.
- [ValidationExceptionFieldList](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionFieldList.md): list.
- [ValidationExceptionReason](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionReason.md): enum. A machine\-readable reason\; clients never need to parse message text\.
- [CountItemsInput](src/shapes/CountItemsInput.md): structure.
- [CountItemsOutput](src/shapes/CountItemsOutput.md): structure.
- [CountUnavailableException](src/shapes/CountUnavailableException.md): error, HTTP 503.
- [DeleteItemInput](src/shapes/DeleteItemInput.md): structure.
- [DeleteItemOutput](src/shapes/DeleteItemOutput.md): structure.
- [GetItemInput](src/shapes/GetItemInput.md): structure.
- [GetItemOutput](src/shapes/GetItemOutput.md): structure.
- [GetLabelInput](src/shapes/GetLabelInput.md): structure.
- [GetLabelOutput](src/shapes/GetLabelOutput.md): structure.
- [ItemNotFoundException](src/shapes/ItemNotFoundException.md): error, HTTP 404.
- [Kind](src/shapes/Kind.md): enum.
- [Kinds](src/shapes/Kinds.md): list.
- [Label](src/shapes/Label.md): structure. An item\'s label\.
- [Labels](src/shapes/Labels.md): list.
- [ListItemsInput](src/shapes/ListItemsInput.md): structure.
- [ListItemsOutput](src/shapes/ListItemsOutput.md): structure.
- [ListLabelsOutput](src/shapes/ListLabelsOutput.md): structure.
- [Names](src/shapes/Names.md): list.
- [PutLabelInput](src/shapes/PutLabelInput.md): structure.
- [PutLabelOutput](src/shapes/PutLabelOutput.md): structure.
- [RecordPaymentInput](src/shapes/RecordPaymentInput.md): structure.
- [RecordPaymentOutput](src/shapes/RecordPaymentOutput.md): structure.
